mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_like (post_id, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like WHERE post_id = #{postId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_like pl INNER JOIN post p ON p.id = pl.post_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1
